43 unspoken laws of etiquette
that cultivate grace, confidence
and quiet power

presence
1. walk slowly
2. sit up straight
3. speak a little lower
4. hold eye contact
5. no rushing, ever
6. dress for the room
7. smile with your eyes

at the table
8. napkin on your lap
9. wait for everyone
10. phone in your bag
11. taste before salting
12. small bites
13. thank the cook
14. never reach across

conversation
15. remember names
16. ask a second question
17. never interrupt
18. no gossip
19. praise in public
20. disagree softly
21. know when to stop

online
22. reply kindly, not fast
23. no voice notes to strangers
24. no group chat drama
25. ask before posting others
26. keep some things private
27. thank people by name
28. log off at dinner

guest and host
29. arrive five minutes late
30. never empty-handed
31. offer help once
32. leave while it's still fun
33. write a thank-you note
34. introduce everyone
35. refill glasses first

integrity
36. be on time
37. keep your word
38. return what you borrow
39. apologise without "but"
40. keep secrets
41. be kind to waiters
42. stay calm under pressure
43. keep learning, every day
